name: DPCLock claimToken pays DPC at manipulable spot quotes
summary: DPCLock.claimToken sets its unlock multiple from the FSP balance of the FSP/DPC pair plus Staking's total stake, and converts each locker's USDT entitlement to DPC with PancakeRouter getAmountsOut spot quotes. With flash-loaned USDT attackers skewed the pairs, locked FSP via swapDPC, claimed inflated DPC and sold it back.
notes: The reset is the owner's setTokenContract(…, 2) repointing _staking from 0x21a01806 to the new Staking 0x34c8ee19: claimToken reads getTotalStakeAmount() and isHolder() from it and swapDPC requires isHolder, so the exploit needed that controller pointer (rule 8).

DPC has no market quote (spot implied about 200,000 USD per DPC against a 23-DPC pool), so the DPC drained from DPCLock is valued at the USDT the five transactions pulled out of the FSP/USDT pair 0x7c1f8f5d, where the stolen DPC was realised (rule 12).
